scope.spy_branch: no_trade: Stage 3A did not show positive aggregate active return after timestamp-safe entry

entry.clock: use only a raw Polymarket observation available strictly before the fill; fill at the next regular-session open

exit.name: volatility_scaled_stop_execution_safe
exit.gap_fill: if opening price is below the stop, exit at the opening price; otherwise exit at the stop when touched
exit.take_profit: none; do not sell merely because an absolute profit percentage is reached
exit.time_exit: market-on-close of the final legal session before T_e

measurement.success: net active return versus QQQ over the exact same entry-to-exit interval
measurement.costs: include benchmark rotation and asset transaction costs
